title: La llave equivocada
scene: A tenant and her neighbour work out why her key no longer opens the door.

segments.speaker: Lucía
segments.text: Buenas tardes, don Ramón. ¿Puedo preguntarle una cosa?
segments.text_en: Good afternoon, don Ramón. Can I ask you something?

segments.speaker: Don Ramón
segments.text_en: Of course, tell me. What's wrong?

segments.speaker: Lucía
segments.text: Mi llave no abre la puerta de abajo. La he probado tres veces.
segments.text_en: My key doesn't open the downstairs door. I've tried it three times.

segments.speaker: Don Ramón
segments.text: Ah, es que cambiaron la cerradura el lunes por la mañana.
segments.text_en: Ah, the thing is they changed the lock on Monday morning.

segments.speaker: Don Ramón
segments.text: Pusieron un aviso en el ascensor, pero se cayó el mismo día.
segments.text_en: They put a notice in the lift, but it fell down the same day.

segments.speaker: Lucía
segments.text: Qué desastre. ¿Y dónde recojo la llave nueva?
segments.text_en: What a disaster. And where do I pick up the new key?

segments.speaker: Don Ramón
segments.text: En la portería, hasta las siete. Ve ahora, que cierran pronto.
segments.text_en: At the porter's desk, until seven. Go now, they close early.

segments.speaker: Lucía
segments.text: Voy corriendo. Muchísimas gracias, de verdad.
segments.text_en: I'm running there. Thank you so much, really.

segments.speaker: Don Ramón
segments.text: De nada, mujer. Para eso estamos los vecinos.
segments.text_en: You're welcome. That's what neighbours are for.

glossary.gloss: the porter's desk, the concierge office
I'm going right now (literally: I'm going running)

grammar_spotlights.explanation: Preterite for a finished event with a closed time frame: they changed it, done.
Irregular affirmative tú command of ir, used for friendly urging.

questions.question: ¿Por qué la llave de Lucía no funciona?
questions.explanation: Don Ramón explains that the lock was changed on Monday morning.

questions.question: ¿Por qué Lucía no sabía nada del cambio?
choices: El aviso se cayó el mismo día
questions.explanation: There was a notice in the lift, but it fell down the same day.

questions.question: ¿Dónde puede recoger la llave nueva?
questions.explanation: Don Ramón says the new key is at la portería until seven.

questions.question: ¿Qué actitud muestra don Ramón al final?
questions.explanation: He brushes off the thanks with para eso estamos los vecinos, a warm and neighbourly line.
